verdict.rationale: Edge0 is an inference engine, so specialized-accelerator support is a fair axis. The evidence shows only a backend facade that a new backend could implement, with even CUDA just a 'reserved slot'. No TPU, Gaudi or other accelerator plugin is documented. That facade is a developer building block, not shipped accelerator support, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run inference on specialized accelerators like TPUs or Gaudi through plugin support

citations.quote: a new backend implements the same facade (`backends/cuda/` is a reserved slot) with zero changes to core code
